name: Faith Love Grace
overview: Scripture reveals that faith, love, and grace are deeply interconnected in the believer's relationship with Christ. Justification and peace with God come through faith in Jesus (Romans 5:1), which is itself a gift of God's grace (Ephesians 2:8). This faith is not passive but actively expresses itself through love, as seen in Galatians where faith works by love (Galatians 5:6), and believers are called to be firmly rooted in love as Christ dwells in their hearts (Ephesians 3:17). The life of the believer is sustained by faith in the Son of God, who loved and gave Himself for us (Galatians 2:20), and love must be sincere and devoted to what is good (Romans 12:9).
